whenToUse: Day, week, month and list views of events: appointments, meetings, classes.
Creating, moving and resizing timed events.
avoidWhen: Resource rows (staff, rooms) — use Resource calendar.
Date picking — use Calendar or Date Picker.
a11y: Events are focusable with time and title in their label; a list view is the accessible fallback.
Drag operations have a keyboard/dialog alternative.
